entities.name: Great Henge
entities.description: A magical artifact on Eldraine: a circle of monoliths atop Castle Garenbrig that becomes a gate to the depths of the wilds at certain sunrises and sunsets.

entities.name: Castle Garenbrig
entities.description: Castle whose outcropping holds the Great Henge.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane where the Great Henge stands.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the Courts fell.

relations.note: Sits atop an outcropping of Castle Garenbrig
relations.quote: sits atop a jutting stone outcropping of Castle Garenbrig
